name: design-dc
description: DataCraft design workflow: design-handoff writes the crossing brief for claude.ai/design (data-driven or concept-driven); html-artifacts produces rich editorial HTML artifacts instead of long markdown; design-sync drives the built-in DesignSync tool to keep a component library in sync with a Claude Design design-system project. Pairs with the claude-design bridge plugin (separate, upstream-tracked) for driving the designer itself.
